title: erythraea centaurium subsp. diffusa
intro: Erythraea centaurium subsp. diffusa, commonly known as the woodland centaury or centaury, is a type of flowering plant in the gentian family, characterized by its unique, yellowish-green flowers and red-tinged leaves. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Erythraea centaurium subsp. diffusa include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and pain, as well as its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as gentianine and gentiopicroside, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and are responsible for its bioactive effects.
